## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #219 closes #218, the immediate child task from parent #217.
- The PR adds `orchestrate` to the model-facing dispatch prompt route list, JSON union, and routing rules so free-form triage can select orchestration for issue and PR targets.
- It also adds a focused consistency test comparing the prompt’s route enumerations against `ROUTES`.
- The broader shared route catalog is intentionally deferred to the next stacked PR.

## Review
The implementation is small, aligned with the parent issue, and has useful drift coverage. One user-facing docs gap remains: the main workflow/action docs still describe orchestration as explicit `/orchestrate` or label-based only.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Document dispatch-triaged orchestration | WARNING | The PR creates a new free-form dispatch entry path for `orchestrate`, but the main docs still describe orchestrator startup as explicit `/orchestrate` or `agent/orchestrate` only. |
| Optional prompt-test cleanup | INFO | One reviewer noted the hardcoded `assert.match(prompt, /Use \`orchestrate\` when/)` is redundant with the route enumeration checks and mildly phrase-fragile. |

## Progress
- Rubrics review passed and confirmed the PR matches the scoped #218 task.
- Existing PR discussion already acknowledges the shared route catalog as the follow-up stacked PR.
- Existing inline comments and review threads were empty before synthesis.
- Posted one new inline comment on `.github/prompts/agent-dispatch.md` line 15 for the docs-sync issue.
- No inline replies, thread resolutions, or minimizations were needed.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Document dispatch-triaged orchestration</summary>

**Cause:** The prompt change makes `orchestrate` selectable by dispatch triage, but [`agent-actions.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/9d811570d7bdf407dbe1c9b860c6c8cd6eb42cf9/.agent/docs/actions/agent-actions.md#L11-L18) and [`supported-workflows.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/9d811570d7bdf407dbe1c9b860c6c8cd6eb42cf9/.agent/docs/architecture/supported-workflows.md#L25-L33) still frame orchestrator startup as explicit `/orchestrate` or `agent/orchestrate`.

**Candidate solutions:** Update those docs to mention that dispatch triage may now select `orchestrate` for explicit orchestration, follow-up automation, or bounded multi-step agent workflow requests on issues and PRs.

**Comments:** The rubrics reviewer treated the prompt update itself as docs coverage, while another reviewer flagged the broader docs gap. Synthesis agrees this is a required docs-sync follow-up because the behavior is user-facing.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Optional prompt-test cleanup</summary>

**Cause:** The new test already checks both prompt route enumerations against `ROUTES`; the extra phrase match pins one exact rule wording.

**Candidate solutions:** Leave it as-is, remove the phrase-specific assertion, or replace it with a route-agnostic guard that the regex found route entries before comparing arrays.

**Comments:** This is not required for merge.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`FIX_PR`: the unresolved docs-sync issue is a concrete, low-risk branch change suitable for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

## Action Items
- [ ] Update the matching agent action/workflow docs to mention dispatch-triaged `orchestrate` starts for issue and PR targets.
